content:
riley: Quick kickoff for the launch playbook. Scope: three social posts (teaser, demo GIF, benchmark), one webinar (next Thu), and a PLG microexperiment testing credit timing + prompt-template exposure. Primary goal = lift first-success within 7 days.

noor: Proposed variants (distinct): CONTROL = no credit; WARM = 500 on signup + 500 bonus after first success within 7d; CONFIRM = 300 on email confirm + 1000 on first success. Randomize 40/40/20. Hypothesis: WARM reduces time-to-first-request, CONFIRM improves quality of activated users.

jamal: For prompt exposure: WARM gets onboarding email with 3 starter prompt templates + GIF; CONFIRM gets templates only after confirm, and full promptpack after first success. Track prompts_sent, prompts_opened, prompts_used. Also add a tiny checklist CTA "Make 1st request" to nudge users.

irvy: Can we enforce credit expiry 14 days and org-level cap 5k? Legal wants the short promo note in the emails.

ops-bot: Staging webhooks deployed: /hooks/grant-warm, /hooks/grant-confirm, /hooks/promptpack-deliver, /hooks/sdr-route. Smoke test IDs: hook_smoke_311, hook_smoke_312. Staging logs: https://ops.internal/tests/hook_smoke_311 :white_check_mark:

jamal: Segment pseudocode we'll push:
```
variant = chooseVariant(user.id, ['CONTROL','WARM','CONFIRM'])
analytics.identify(user.id, {launch_variant: variant})
if (variant == 'WARM') post('/hooks/grant-warm', {user_id, amount:500, req_id})
if (variant == 'CONFIRM') await email_confirm -> post('/hooks/grant-confirm', {user_id, amount:300, req_id})
```
Include idempotency token and TTL for unlock bonuses.

noor: Webinar flow: register -> confirm -> reminder 24h/1h/15m -> live. Attenders get extra 1200 credits + promptpack. No-shows get 300 if they watch recording within 48h. Route high-fit leads (company_size >=50 OR intent_score >=0.7 OR mrr_est >=5k) to SDR via /hooks/sdr-route with payload {user_id,email,company_size,intent_score,launch_variant,request_id}.

riley: Creative asks: 20s benchmark GIF script showing cost per prompt drop and median latency before/after batching & KV-cache. Need three captions for X and a longer LI benchmark narrative. Also Product Hunt blurb under 120 words that calls out the experiment and webinar CTA.

jamal: Analytics events: launch_signup, launch_confirm, credit_granted, bonus_unlocked, first_success, prompts_sent, prompts_used, webinar_attend. Tag events with variant and utm_campaign. Dashboards: 24h and 7d cohort windows, token-cost-per-activation, and credit burn rate.

irvy: For dashboards, include confidence intervals for lift at 7d and a small table of median latency pre/post. Noah from analytics will wire BigQuery events.

ops-bot: Notes: all hooks are idempotent by req_id and return existing credit_id on duplicate calls. Staging verified.

riley: Action items: noor -> finalize variant allocation + email copy; jamal -> promptpack content + creative briefs; irvy -> legal blurb + expiry wording; ops-bot -> provide final smoke logs; analytics -> dashboard spec. Quick check-in tomorrow 9:30am PT to sign off. :rocket:
